text: Handling deadlines well requires good planning and clear communication. First, time management is key: create a schedule and break large tasks into smaller steps. Second, prioritization helps you focus on the most important work first, so you don't waste time on small details. Third, scope management means being realistic about what you can finish. If a task is too big, discuss reducing it early rather than missing the deadline. Finally, communication is essential. Tell your team or manager about problems as soon as they appear, not at the last minute. With these four skills, deadlines become less stressful and much easier to meet.
